product_one_liner.value: Fundraise Up is an online donation platform that helps nonprofits accept donations, manage fundraising campaigns, and increase giving.
product_one_liner.notes: The getting-started documentation describes a web-based platform for nonprofits to accept donations, increase giving, and create and manage fundraising campaigns. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/docs/get-started.

pricing_page.notes: A public nonprofit fundraising pricing page exists and advertises $0 upfront and no long-term contracts. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company's customer case-study index identifies UNICEF USA and Canadian Red Cross as customers. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/case-studies. | named_customers.0: UNICEF USA is named in a customer success story on https://fundraiseup.com/case-studies. | named_customers.1: Canadian Red Cross is named with a customer-story link on https://fundraiseup.com/case-studies.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 350+ team members, which maps to the requested 201-500 band. The stated figure is approximate and does not explicitly establish an upper bound. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/about.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly identifies Brooklyn, New York as its headquarters. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/about. | hq_country: The About page identifies Brooklyn, New York as headquarters, and the company's organization metadata explicitly gives its address country as US. Sources: https://fundraiseup.com/about and https://fundraiseup.com/careers/4674966005.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2017: https://fundraiseup.com/about.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents product updates, fundraising guidance, and news/knowledge content, not the required two engineer-authored implementation posts. This negative assessment is based on the inspected index rather than merely the absence of an engineering label. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple onboarding and product articles, including Stripe setup, installation, and payment methods. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/docs/get-started.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior ML-Engineer posting explicitly seeks an ML engineer and provides an application link; it was verified on November 10, 2026. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/careers/4674966005.

model_provider.notes: The Trust Center names Anthropic for AI processing supporting Agentic Giving and platform features. The public subprocessor list names Claude for the Agentic Giving feature when enabled. This establishes product use, not merely compatibility with external assistants; no specific Claude version is stated. Sources: https://trust.fundraiseup.com/compliance and https://fundraiseup.com/subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and PCI DSS compliance, including dated audit documents rather than in-progress certifications. These are public compliance claims; GDPR is not itself a formal certification. Source: https://trust.fundraiseup.com/compliance. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center lists a SOC 2 Type 2 report dated March 2026: https://trust.fundraiseup.com/compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center lists an ISO 27001 document: https://trust.fundraiseup.com/compliance. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR appears among the Trust Center's compliance claims: https://trust.fundraiseup.com/compliance. | compliance_certs.3: The Trust Center lists a PCI DSS 4.0.1 attestation dated May 2026: https://trust.fundraiseup.com/compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile labels the January 2025 $70 million round Series B. The investor announcement calls it a growth investment without using the Series B label, so the stage classification relies on the secondary funding profile. Source: https://fundediq.co/fundraise-up-fundraiseup-com-funding. | funding_date: Both the funding profile and investor announcement place the investment in January 2025. Their day-level dates differ, but that does not affect the requested YYYY-MM value. Sources: https://fundediq.co/fundraise-up-fundraiseup-com-funding and https://www.summitpartners.com/news/fundraise-up-secures-70-million-growth-capital-investment-led-by-summit-partners. | funding_amount_usd: The investor announcement establishes a $70 million growth investment. The funding profile, verified in November 2026, identifies the January 2025 round as the latest listed round. Sources: https://www.summitpartners.com/news/fundraise-up-secures-70-million-growth-capital-investment-led-by-summit-partners and https://fundediq.co/fundraise-up-fundraiseup-com-funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round occurred in January 2025, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. The November 2026-verified funding profile lists no later round. Sources: https://fundediq.co/fundraise-up-fundraiseup-com-funding and https://www.summitpartners.com/news/fundraise-up-secures-70-million-growth-capital-investment-led-by-summit-partners.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive, Education Vertical posting provides an Apply Now link and was verified on November 10, 2026. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/careers/4735043005.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 1, 2026 changelog announces Agentic Giving, which enables AI assistants to read live campaigns and recommend them to supporters. This is substantive new functionality within the six-month window. Source: https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/reach-supporters-through-ai-assistants-with-agentic-giving.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A November 2, 2026 announcement reports that John Schneider joined as Chief Marketing Officer, within the requested 12-month window. The available announcement is a secondary report citing his LinkedIn announcement. Source: https://karvtechinsider.com/martech/cxo-moves/john-schneider-joins-fundraise-up-as-chief-marketing-officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Scratchpad's customer case study names Salesforce, Scratchpad, and Gong in Fundraise Up's technology stack. HubSpot's case study describes its Sales and Marketing hubs being used by Fundraise Up's own teams. These are documented usage signals, although the pages do not establish that all systems remain in simultaneous use. Sources: https://www.scratchpad.com/customers/case-studies/fundraise-up and https://www.hubspot.com/case-studies/fundraise-up?size=thousand_plus+. | crm_stack_signal.0: Salesforce is named in Fundraise Up's technology stack and CRM workflow: https://www.scratchpad.com/customers/case-studies/fundraise-up. | crm_stack_signal.1: The customer case study documents Fundraise Up standardizing seller workflows in Scratchpad: https://www.scratchpad.com/customers/case-studies/fundraise-up. | crm_stack_signal.2: Gong is explicitly named in Fundraise Up's technology stack: https://www.scratchpad.com/customers/case-studies/fundraise-up. | crm_stack_signal.3: HubSpot's case study documents its Sales and Marketing hubs being used by Fundraise Up's teams. This is a public usage signal, but the older case study does not establish continued current use. Source: https://www.hubspot.com/case-studies/fundraise-up?size=thousand_plus+.
